race.description: Jim, Tess And Jamie Irving Memorial Hcp (C1)
race.comment: RICHY RIC (6) missed the start but recovered to record an impressive win on debut over 1200m at Wagga last start. Draws well again and if the barrier manners improve another win beckons. INSPIRING (2) returned from an 18-week spell recently and recorded his maiden win at start seven, blitzing his rivals with sheer speed over 1000m at Corowa. Getting this trip strongly is the query but he is back in career-best form. GURU TWO (3) is here following an eight-month lay-off. Gets back in his races which explains the modest strike rate. Each-way chance while fresh. TRANSPORTER (1) returns from a seven-month break for a second campaign. Took a run before hitting his straps when last in work but should be more forward at the start of this prep. Worth including. I'VE FORGOTTEN (9) is a chance based on a sound maiden win over a similar trip at Wagga Riverside two starts ago.
